Business Development Executive Job at Fadac Resources and Services




        
    

        
        Fadac Resources and Services is a Consulting firm that provides businesses with human capital solutions that can help improve oral performance while reducing employment practice risk. They also help organizations no matter how large or small to establish, outsource and troubleshoot any human resources functions/challenges.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Business Development Executive 

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a results-driven Business Development Lead to drive the adoption of our cooperative society management software.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and converting cooperative societies, thrift societies, unions, and related organisations into clients.
	This role requires strong sales and relationship-building skills, the ability to clearly communicate product value, and a proactive approach to meeting revenue targets.


Key Responsibilities
Prospecting and Lead Generation:


	Identify and target cooperative societies, thrift societies, credit unions, and similar organisations.
	Research industry trends and potential clients to build a strong pipeline of prospects.
	Generate leads through networking events, association meetings, referrals, and online platforms.


Sales and Relationship Management:


	Conduct product demonstrations and present the benefits of the software to decision-makers.
	Develop and deliver tailored proposals that address the specific needs of each organisation.
	Build and maintain long-term client relationships that support renewals and referrals. • Closing and Commercial Discussions
	Close deals based on the approved pricing structure.
	Discuss and agree commercial terms such as payment plans, contract duration, volume packages, and onboarding arrangements within company guidelines.
	Ensure smooth handover to the implementation and support teams after closing.


Collaboration and Reporting:


	Work closely with the product, support, and technical teams to ensure successful client onboarding.
	Track and report on sales activities, pipeline status, and revenue forecasts.
	Provide market feedback to support continuous improvement of the product and sales approach.


Qualifications


	Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
	3–5 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, or software/SaaS sales.
	Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
	Experience selling to cooperative societies, financial institutions, or communitybased organisations is an advantage.


Skills:


	Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
	Strong closing and commercial discussion skills.
	Ability to build and maintain professional relationships.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
	Basic understanding of accounting principles and cooperative financial operations is highly preferred.


Method of Application

Job Position: Senior Structural Consultant Resident Engineer (Supervision)

	Acts as the client&rsquo;s principal technical representative on-site, supervising and auditing the structural contractors&#39; works (piling, foundations, reinforced concrete elements, and structural steel framing).

Construction Supervision &amp; Structural Quality Assurance (QA/QC):


	Conducts continuous, rigorous field inspections to monitor the contractor&#39;s structural works (piling operations, reinforcement rebar bending/fixing, formwork stability, and concrete casting).
	Uses extensive contractor-side experience to proactively identify critical field errors, corner-cutting, sub-standard steel fixing, poor concrete compaction, or premature formwork removal.
	Issues Non-Conformance Reports (NCR) to contractors immediately when structural elements fail to meet project specifications or safety standards, and monitors corrective actions.
	Witnesses, monitors, and certifies all critical structural testing phases (e.g., pile load tests, ultrasonic concrete tests, rebar tensile strength tests, and concrete cube compressive strength crushing tests).


Drawing Review &amp; Technical Auditing:


	Critically reviews and approves/rejects the contractor&rsquo;s BIM (Revit Structural) models, shop drawings, rebar bending schedules (BBS), and formwork design drawings before site execution.
	Evaluates contractor material submittals (cement brands, aggregate quality, rebar mill certificates, and concrete mix designs) to verify exact compliance with the consultant&rsquo;s specifications.
	Resolves complex on-site spatial conflicts and coordinates structural elements with mechanical, electrical, and architectural consultant teams to ensure proper MEP wall and floor openings.


Contract Administration &amp; Financial Control:


	Reviews, audits, and signs off on the structural contractor&rsquo;s monthly progress valuations and joint measurements alongside the Quantity Surveyor.
	Assesses the technical and financial merit of contractor-submitted Variation Orders (VOs) and claims, defending the client against unsubstantiated costs.
	Evaluates and approves the contractor&#39;s structural &quot;As-Built&quot; records and material tracing logs prior to building handover.


Lagos Structural Regulatory Enforcement:


	Ensures the contractor&rsquo;s methods align fully with the National Building Code of Nigeria (NBC) and localized geotechnical guidelines.
	Coordinates and prepares the structural project technical documentation required for formal stage-by-stage inspections and ultimate certification by the Lagos State Building Control Agency (LASBCA) and the Lagos State Materials Testing Laboratory (LSMTL).


Required Qualifications &amp; Competencies

	Bachelor&rsquo;s degree (B.Eng/B.Sc) in Civil or Structural Engineering from an accredited university.
	Mandatory Active Registration with the Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria (COREN) as a Registered Engineer.
	Corporate Membership with the Nigerian Society of Engineers (NSE) or the Nigerian Institution of Structural Engineers (NIStructE) is highly required.
	Valid NYSC discharge or exemption certificate.


Experience Profile:


	Minimum of 10 years of total post-qualification experience in structural engineering.
	Dual-Perspective Track Record: Must have a blended career history, featuring significant time spent executing foundations and structural frames on-site for a reputable civil engineering Contractor, alongside experience working in a Consultant/Supervisory capacity.
	Proven experience representing structural consultants on active major building sites&mdash;specifically high-rise structures navigating the challenging soil profiles and high water tables of Lagos (e.g., Ikoyi, Victoria Island, Lekki, or Lagos Mainland).


Technical &amp; Soft Skills:


	Deep expertise in international structural engineering codes used in Nigeria (Eurocodes, British Standards BS 8110 / BS 5950, and local building regulations).
	Thorough technical knowledge of geotechnical engineering fields, including deep foundation systems (bored piles, driven piles, raft foundations) and structural concrete/steel execution.
	Mastery in reading and evaluating complex Revit (BIM Structural) and AutoCAD engineering drawings.
	Assertive communication and negotiation skills needed to confidently manage, direct, and hold contractors accountable on-site.
	Impeccable technical report writing skills (site inspection logs, non-conformance reports, and structural milestone reports).


Method of Application&nbsp;

	Responsible for stewarding contractor interface activities throughout contract life cycle
	Participate in service planning and develop contract strategy
	Act as a liaison and coordinator among Procurement, SSH&E and Operations within the business line
	Establish and maintain the Active Contractor Tracking Database
